//: Build-time tooling, NOT deployed code. The functions tsconfig has rootDir 'src' and emits to lib/, so anything here would either be refused by it or shipped in the deploy bundle. This config type-checks the generator on its own (`npm run typecheck` runs both) and is the --project ts-node reads at run time. The src/ schemas it imports are checked transitively, so they are not listed in `include` again.
//ts-node: The module override has to track the base. ts-node merges this block over the inherited compilerOptions, so leaving 'commonjs' here against the base's 'nodenext' moduleResolution is the TS5110 pairing error and the generator would fail to start. 'nodenext' still emits CommonJS for these files (no `type: module` above them), which is what ts-node needs.
